notes.title: DECK COLLECTOR v0.2.1
notes.content:
DECK COLLECTOR v0.2.1
Collector Mode introduces a walkable 3D environment where you can place objects, unbox packs, unbox preconstructed decks of cards, go shopping, add cards to binders, check out each card in detail, add posters and canvas art, view your collection progress, and more!



Object placement and editing tool:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571635/9233a8716ef2d884fd19e328d78a8f5870914b96.png"]

View cards in detail:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571635/58cf214193026325ed95e6574a85a76498adafae.png"]

Add Posters:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571635/24361629ada2b3ce458dfc5cb49bf6f66cb570e7.png"]

Ultra Realism!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571635/098957b0684509599319c2e7795f736201ff49b7.png"]

Place cards in 3D binders:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571635/98feeaad003e592439eacc67fc6172da674cd785.png"]

This update is the initial milestone where the game comes to life! There are a massive amount of features in this update:

Build your collection by placing cards in 3D binders with a FIRST OF ITS KIND page-offset for ultra realism

Multiple sets, packs, and decks of cards to open

View each card in stunning detail with ultra realistic holographic foils

User controllability through the settings page

All settings files are in plain text format for easy editing

Realistic graphics using PBR

Import your own Rooms and Objects to play in game!

View your progress of each set and deck

Cinematic camera with THOUSANDS of combinations for cinematic video

Pick your color to colorize your game!

Changeable images for some backgrounds

3D posters and canvas art where you can use your own photos

Image and text import style mechanics

Control the look of the game with camera settings (color adjustments, bloom, depth of field, vignette, etc…)

Import textures for Lens Dirt and Overlays

Auto-focus depth of field

Free-play style gameplay, open as many packs as you want!

Go to the store to buy objects, products, furniture, binders, trading cards, lights, TVs, and more!

Jump in now to crack open some packs!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571635/f6976dc52ab2893c631fb237b6ad3f46e6808068.gif"]
